'''Bogman''' is a minor character in {{SA}}. 

His name is never revealed in the game, but can be seen in the game's files. Bogman wears a brown cap, a brown hood over a yellow shirt, blue jeans and yellow shoes.

==History==
===Background===
Although not confirmed, it is possible that he has ties to the Ballas and may have been one of the individuals involved in the [[The Introduction|assassination]] of [[Beverly Johnson]], as one of the three Ballas members in an alleyway, talking about Grove Street before the assassination, closely resembles Bogman.

===Events of ''Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas''===
He first [[In the Beginning|appears]] briefly as the [[Taxi (3D Universe)|Taxi]] driver who takes [[Carl Johnson]] to [[Grove Street (3D Universe)|Grove Street]], but is stopped by a [[Police (vehicle)|Police]] car carrying three [[C.R.A.S.H.]] officers; [[Frank Tenpenny]], [[Eddie Pulaski]], and [[Jimmy Hernandez]], before being dismissed by Pulaski. He later makes a brief [[Madd Dogg's Rhymes|appearance]] in the [[Burger Shot (3D Universe)|Burger Shot]] restroom, where he insults [[OG Loc (3D Universe)|OG Loc]] over his poor song before walking out. 

His final [[Ice Cold Killa|appearance]] occurs inside [[Jizzy's Pleasure Domes|Jizzy’s Pleasure Domes]] during the confrontation between CJ and [[Jizzy B.]], where he is seen among Jizzy’s bodyguards and prostitutes. Bogman’s fate remains unknown, as he is not explicitly seen among the attackers targeting CJ in-game, instead being replaced by generic [[Crack Dealers|crack dealer]] pedestrians. However, it is possible that he does not have a unique in-game model and is actually represented as one of these crack dealers, which could explain both his sudden disappearance and the immediate arrival of multiple dealers at the exact spot where he was sitting.

== Appearance ==
Bogman is a black male, wearing a plum-purple matching hoodie and ballcap, a yellow T-shirt, dark blue jeans, and brown work boots. He is bald, according to his texture files.

A similar-looking Ballas gangster appears during [[The Introduction]]. This is because this gangster uses Bogman's head model mated to the torso of [[Ballas2]]. Due to Bogman's head model being unadulerated, his default purple clothing in the game, and the fact that the [[Burger Shot (3D Universe)|Burger Shot]] that OG Loc worked at is located within [[Temple Drive Ballas]] territory, it is speculated that this member is Bogman himself.

==Trivia==
*There is an unused model in gta3.img called Poolguy. The texture looks identical to Bogman, except he has dark blue clothes and a different face. The cap, however remains identical. When trying to enable it, the game crashes.<ref>[[:File:Poolguy.PNG|The unused ''Poolguy'' model, used on Bogman's model]].</ref>
*"Bog" is a British slang for a toilet. His ID, Bogman, literally means ''Man in the Toilet''. This is because his first speaking appearance was him coming out of the toilet in Burger Shot.
